summary: One shape vocabulary across Button and Badge: `full` and `soft`. Button's `pill` becomes `full` and Badge's `pill`/`rounded` become `full`/`soft` — the same two shapes had two different names in the only two components that have them, and `pill` named the DRAWING where every other value in this system names the token. The redrawn Button sheet settles it in its own legend: 'Button variants: Default (soft border radius), Rounded Full'. Both type-test files keep a compile-time assertion that the old names no longer compile, so they cannot drift back in quietly.

migration.manual: Rename `shape="pill"` to `shape="full"` on Button and Badge, and `shape="rounded"` to `shape="soft"` on Badge. Defaults are unchanged in behaviour: Button still defaults to soft, Badge still defaults to the fully rounded shape (now spelled `full`).
